sections.title: History
sections.content: During the mission to slay Ragruvord, Fadahl receives a message from a disciple about the dissenters who intend to harm Karna Masta. Colt, along with his twin-sister and Fadahl, choose to go back to aid Karna Masta. Shortly after they arrives at the battlefield, they fought the Oracle Knight and his party. During the fight, the same disciple who gave a revelation to Fadahl launches an attack to Colt, but Claire shields him from the attack, at the cost of her life.

{{incomplete}} {{Character |name = Colt |image = [[File:navi chara66 0.png|300px|center]]
''Artwork from Grand Quest'' |element = Water |gender = M |eyes = Red |hair = Blue |skin = Fair |gamedebut = Lizeria |currently = Grand Gaia (deceased) |relatives = {{c|Claire}} (older twin sister) |counterpart = [[Colt]] }} '''Colt''' is one of the Sacred Guardians of Meirith devoted into protecting the Holy Emperor Karna Masta. He is the younger twin brother of Claire, who is also a Guardian. ==History== During the mission to slay Ragruvord, [[Fadahl (character)|Fadahl]] receives a message from [[Melord (character)|a disciple]] about the dissenters who intend to harm Karna Masta. Colt, along with [[Claire (character)|his twin-sister]] and Fadahl, choose to go back to aid Karna Masta. Shortly after they arrives at the battlefield, they fought the [[Ark (character)|Oracle Knight]] and his party. During the fight, the same disciple who gave a revelation to Fadahl launches an attack to Colt, but Claire shields him from the attack, at the cost of her life. ==Character==
